title: 阿祖爾煉油廠
summary: 阿祖爾工程由多個 EPC 套件組成；本課以分包接口與全廠產品、公用設施帳檢查整合完整性。本課依序分析分包到全廠收率、套件間熱量交接、氫氣使用者分配、不同承包商資料基準、整體可用率限制，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Al-Zour was delivered through multiple EPC packages; this case checks integration through package interfaces and plant-wide balances. The course analyses package-to-site yield account, thermal handover between packages, allocation among hydrogen users, data bases across contractors, site-wide availability constraints, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 分包到全廠收率、套件間熱量交接、氫氣使用者分配
v31FocusEn: Package-to-site yield account; Thermal handover between packages; Allocation among hydrogen users

quiz.question: 關於「分包到全廠收率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Package-to-site yield account" is correct?
options: 煉製產品分率是質量帳的分類，不是把原油簡單按名稱切開；氣體、液體、焦炭與損失都應納入同一基準。
產品總體積大於原料體積就表示違反質量守恆。
只要增加熱交換面積就能回收全部廢熱。
optionsEn: Refinery product fractions classify a mass balance; crude is not merely separated by product names.
Product volume exceeding feed volume violates mass conservation.
Increasing exchanger area recovers all waste heat.

steps.title: 分包到全廠收率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Package-to-site yield account: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分包到全廠收率」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Package-to-site yield account” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：M = Feed yield；代入 F = 34500 tonne/day feed、y = 0.35 mass fraction product yield，得 12,075 t/day（「分包到全廠收率」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 y 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: M = Feed yield; with F = 34500 tonne/day feed, y = 0.35 mass fraction product yield the result is 12,075 t/day (simplified exercise for Package-to-site yield account; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise y by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：y 增加 10% 時，結果變為 13,282 t/day（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising y by 10% changes the result to 13,282 t/day (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 12,075 t/day（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 y 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 12,075 t/day (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in y with an engineering explanation.

Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.

steps.title: 分包到全廠收率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Package-to-site yield account: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分包到全廠收率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Package-to-site yield account” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「分包到全廠收率」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。把假設產品分率加總至一，檢查質量收率與體積收率是否被混用；再以原料變動情境重算所有產品。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Package-to-site yield account”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Sum assumed product fractions to one, check for mixing mass and volume yields, and recalculate all products for a feed-change scenario. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 047-01 標記，圖表須寫明「阿祖爾煉油廠：教學假設」。交付質量與體積兩張分開的表，以密度關聯並標示品質與商業規格未由本模型驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 047-01 and mark charts “Al-Zour refinery: teaching assumptions”. Deliver separate mass and volume tables connected by density, noting that product quality and commercial specification remain unverified by this model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「分包到全廠收率」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Package-to-site yield account” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 分包到全廠收率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Package-to-site yield account: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分包到全廠收率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Package-to-site yield account” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「分包到全廠收率」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。密度較低的成品可能使體積收率超過百分之百，這不等於創造質量；漏列氣體或焦炭則會使質量帳無法閉合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「阿祖爾煉油廠」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Package-to-site yield account” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Lower-density products may produce volume yield above one hundred percent without creating mass; omitting gas or coke prevents the mass account from closing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Al-Zour refinery”.
